title: Apolitical Intelligence? Auditing Delphi’s responses on controversial political issues in the US
findings: The paper does not report findings specifically for the religious questions. The overall finding is that the model, Delphi, exhibits a significant political skew, aligning more closely with left-wing US political parties (e.g., Democrats, Peace and Freedom party) and less with right-wing parties (e.g., Republicans). This implies the model would likely adopt left-leaning stances on the tested religious issues, such as opposing service denial based on religious beliefs and supporting the separation of church and state.
references: Abubakar Abid, Maheen Farooqi, and James Zou. 2021. Persistent anti-muslim bias in large language models. In Proceedings of the 2021 AAAI/ACM Conference on AI, Ethics, and Society. 298-306.
